title: Cassoulet with White Beans and Savory Sausage
description: A classic French dish made with white beans, savory sausage, and a crispy crust. Perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the white beans, cassoulet broth, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the sausage to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the French baguette into 1-inch slices.
After 30 minutes, remove the pot from the oven and top the bean mixture with the baguette slices.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Serve the cassoulet hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
